ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigation into Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the extent of the fraud and the effectiveness of the state's anti-fraud efforts
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records review
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How effective are the state's anti-fraud efforts?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the need for increased oversight and enforcement. I will use data analysis and public records review to investigate the extent of the fraud and the effectiveness of the state's anti-fraud efforts.
